surfaceMatrix.summary: Repository and external receipt heads must match before every chain extension.
The receipt directory rejects symbolic-link traversal and must resolve beneath the evidence root.
Redacted candidate and execution artifacts are published before their authenticated receipt advances.
Candidate-run identity includes the exact canonical model ID digest and cannot collapse on punctuation normalization.
The existing privacy, budget, route, freshness, abstention, and one-use execution boundaries remain green.

residualRisks: Live OpenRouter behavior remains outside offline CI and needs an explicit field-operation grant.
V1-07 must compose recommendation authorization with exact receipt and current-policy verification.
